scripts.build: wp-scripts build && npm run copy:assets && npm run minify:assets
scripts.minify:assets: npx clean-css-cli -o assets/admin.css assets/admin.css && npx clean-css-cli -o assets/admin-rtl.css assets/admin-rtl.css
scripts.sync:assets: npm run copy:assets && npm run minify:assets
scripts.plugin-zip: cd .. && rm -f media-library-manager.zip && zip -r media-library-manager.zip media-library-manager -x@media-library-manager/.zipignore
